MMRVN for Agri Labour children — Eligibility

Caste | All
Family annual income | <= Rs. 2.5 lakhs
Course Type | All
College Type | All
College Seat Type | All
Promotion status | Promoted to present year
Parent's occupation | Parent must be a Agriculture labour
Any other condition | Must have valid FRUITS ID and data available in Kutumba database.

Mukhya Mantri Raitha Vidhya Nidhi - Eligibility
Caste All
Family annual income <= Rs. 2.5 lakhs
Course Type All
College Type All
College Seat Type All
Promotion status Promoted to present year
Any other condition Any family member must have agriculture land, have valid FRUITS ID and data must be available in KUTUMBA database. Students eligible under other schemes are not eligible.
